summary.text: Jeff Hoverson is a Republican member of the North Dakota House of Representatives, representing District 3 (home city listed as Minot), serving since 2019 per the legislature's member page.

paragraphs.text: The legislature's biography for Hoverson lists an occupation of Clergy.
It lists education as Master of Divinity.
Family is listed as: Married (JoAnn); 6 children.
For the 2025 regular session, the page lists Hoverson's standing committee assignments as Agriculture and Judiciary.
